claims.claim: YOLOv5 v7.0 is a versioned Ultralytics source-code release rather than a YOLOv1-v3 Redmon paper
claims.notes: Scope is classic v7.0 object detection task.

claims.claim: YOLOv5s v7.0 YAML contains C3, SPPF and multiscale PAN-style up/down routes
v7.0 Detect.forward decodes xy=(2sigmoid(tx)-0.5+grid)*stride and wh=(2sigmoid(tw))^2 * anchor
claims.notes: Anchor pixel units and grid shift explicitly recognized.

claims.claim: For 640 input with strides 8/16/32, 3 anchors per cell yield 25200 raw candidates
v7.0 training/validation/detection/export use separate root scripts and CLI arguments
claims.notes: Commands are instructed, not executed in this repository.

claims.claim: YOLOv5 classic dataset labels follow class cx cy w h normalized coordinate scheme
claims.notes: No implied support for masks/segmentation in this exercise.

claims.claim: AutoAnchor checks and may evolve anchor priors during training
claims.notes: Not an inference-time box reranking routine.

claims.claim: The zero-logit xywh at grid (4,6), stride32, anchor116x90 decodes to center144/208 and dimensions116/90
claims.locator: Detect.forward formula verified by stdlib lab
claims.notes: Toy deterministic data; not real inference.

claims.claim: The example class names bolt/nut and 100 epochs are placeholders
claims.notes: No training metrics or real deployment speed claimed.
